scope: All 26 roadmap modules A00-A25, including UI, media, auditing and release
method: Transparent engineering effort points assigned once per module. Full credit only for independently verified module with evidence and explicit owner acceptance. Partial modules receive zero rather than guessed fractional credit.
milestone_rule: Owner-operated Windows acceptance when the VERIFIED and OWNER-ACCEPTED weighted floor first passes another 10% gate; security gate may require earlier test. No regular test for every hotfix.
estimated_schedule: Not calibrated to calendar time; no ETA can be inferred from module count alone
note: These weights are planning assumptions only. They do not update MODULE_REGISTRY.project_completion_percent until the owner agrees weights and implementation acceptance criteria.
